header.contentDescription: How a heat pump works, in four steps: a loop diagram showing the current step, its caption, step dots, and previous, play and next buttons

semantics.contentDescription: Diagram of the heat pump loop: outside coil, compressor, indoor coil and valve, with the current step's part filled
Picture of the part of the heat pump this step is about

text.value: Outdoor air warms a very cold fluid in the outside coil, even on a freezing day. It turns to gas.
The compressor squeezes the gas. That packs its heat together, so the gas gets very hot.
The hot gas runs through a coil indoors and gives its heat to the radiators and hot water.
The cooled fluid passes a valve. Its pressure drops, it turns very cold, and the loop starts again.
Outdoor air warms the cold fluid.
Squeezing makes the gas very hot.
The hot gas warms your home.
A valve makes it cold again.
